description:
Make a person in a video speak: generates a lip-synced version of a Kling video from text (text-to-speech) or an audio file.

WORKFLOW:
1. Identify the video: video_id (from a completed Kling task) or video_url (public HTTPS .mp4/.mov, ≤100MB, 2-10s, 720p/1080p)
2. Choose mode:
   - "text2video": Kling speaks your text — requires text (max 120 chars) + voice_id
   - "audio2video": sync to your own audio — requires audio_url (HTTPS) or audio_path (local file)
3. Call this tool → returns task_id, then poll with check_kling_task(task_id, task_type="lip-sync")

AUDIO (audio2video): .mp3/.wav/.m4a/.aac, max 5MB. audio_path must be inside MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH (or the system temp directory).

audio_path.description: Absolute path to a local audio file inside MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH (or the system temp directory). Formats: .mp3/.wav/.m4a/.aac, max 5MB.

audio_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the audio file (.mp3/.wav/.m4a/.aac, max 5MB). Required when mode is "audio2video" unless audio_path is given.

callback_url.description: HTTPS URL that Kling POSTs the task result to when the task status changes. Optional — polling with check_kling_task works without it.

mode.description: "text2video": Kling speaks the text. "audio2video": sync to a supplied audio file.

text.description: The spoken text (max 120 characters). Required when mode is "text2video".

video_id.description: ID of a video generated by Kling (the video.id from a completed task result, NOT the task_id). 5-10s videos generated within the last 30 days. Provide either video_id or video_url, not both.

video_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the video to lip-sync (.mp4/.mov, ≤100MB, 2-10s, 720p or 1080p). Provide either video_id or video_url, not both.

voice_id.description: Voice ID from the Kling voice catalog (see https://app.klingai.com/global/dev/document-api). Required when mode is "text2video".

name: generate_kling_lip_sync
